requested_outcome: Implement the thirteen accepted Liran and Plumbo requirements, verify the affected families, publish one cumulative production version, and obtain evidence-based simulated-Adir approval on the live version
authorization_boundary: Local code, tests, production publication and post-release verification are authorized by the current user request; no supplier-data mutation, DNS change, outbound messaging, purchase or unrelated production change is authorized

lesson_bundle.reason: The task must predict the likely rejection points before implementation
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires a complete family inventory, midpoint slice, adversarial close and measurable evidence

lesson_bundle.reason: The result must be public and complete rather than code-only
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires exact deployed identity, live functional and visual proof, and representative post-deploy scenarios

lesson_bundle.reason: The changes affect existing search, amenities and gallery capabilities
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires preservation checks for existing accepted behavior across every affected world

lesson_bundle.reason: Search loading, show-all controls and media buttons are interactive stateful changes
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires desktop, mobile, reload, back, open, close and low-height checks

lesson_bundle.reason: The reported search defect is missing immediate stable loading feedback
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires one stable busy state, no provisional results, duplicate prevention and a clear final state

lesson_bundle.reason: Several requirements are mobile-first and visual
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Requires inspected public mobile screenshots and live mobile interaction evidence

predicted_rejections.rejection: A full page still inherits the twenty-card rail cap
predicted_rejections.prevention: Trace selection and rendering helpers separately for rails and grids and compare final identities with the supplier-backed result set
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Vacation period and event filter pages render every eligible identity and rail components remain intentionally bounded

predicted_rejections.rejection: Amenities look cleaner but unit-only facts are falsely promoted to the whole property or duplicated
predicted_rejections.prevention: Preserve source scope while deduplicating stable feature identities and render five collapsed rows plus one show-all control
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Collapsed and expanded public business pages show correct scoped facts with no duplicates and one accessible toggle

predicted_rejections.rejection: Search still flashes temporary cards or counts before settling
predicted_rejections.prevention: Keep prior verified results or a skeleton while one request owns the commit and replace results atomically
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Cold-cache, throttled, filter and back journeys show no provisional card or count swap

predicted_rejections.rejection: Video and gallery controls work only on one viewport or appear for invalid media
predicted_rejections.prevention: Use one shared verified-media predicate and shared accessible controls for desktop and mobile
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Valid, missing and broken-video cases plus duplicate gallery-title negative cases pass on both viewports

predicted_rejections.rejection: The deployment claims completion without the exact public build and live inspection
predicted_rejections.prevention: Freeze one clean source, publish once after gates, record deployment identity and run live actor journeys before simulated review
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The public metadata, live routes, screenshots and actor ledger all bind to one exact deployed version

affected_family: vacation fixed-period and holiday result pages
event filter result pages and result counts
shared search loading state and result commit path
vacation business amenities from property and unit sources
shared business gallery title and full-gallery control
verified business video controls on desktop and mobile
Hebrew accessibility names and keyboard states
cold cache, warm cache, reload, back and responsive transitions

sources.label: Accepted Liran and Plumbo execution list
Airbnb-style five-amenity reference supplied by Adir

midpoint_gate.trigger: The first focused contract tests and one local mobile and desktop business-page render pass
checks: Result grids remain uncapped while rails remain bounded
Amenities collapse to five plain icon-text rows and expand through one control
Video and gallery controls use verified media and accessible names
Search loading does not expose provisional results

attack_questions: Can a dated or period page still stop at twenty while the API has more eligible identities?
Can a unit-only amenity appear as a property-wide fact or appear twice after expansion?
Can a slow request expose changing cards or counts before the final commit?
Can a missing or broken video still produce an actionable video button?
Can the public version differ from the source and screenshots inspected by the reviewer?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Exact public build identity plus live desktop and 390-pixel mobile journeys on vii.spaplus.co
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated identity, interaction, accessibility and responsive tests plus public route and screenshot ledger

effectiveness.baseline: The user reported repeated regressions and two current loading and data-parity failures; a stable first-pass acceptance baseline is unavailable
effectiveness.target: All thirteen requirements pass before publication, zero open simulated-review findings remain after the public correction loop, and no accepted predecessor capability regresses
